issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מַלְאֲכֵי מֶלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן' means 'messengers of the king of Samaria' (human messengers), but the Chinese renders it as '撒瑪利亞王的天使' (angels of the king of Samaria), incorrectly translating 'מַלְאֲכֵי' as '天使' (angels) instead of '使者/臣僕' (messengers). This changes the meaning from human envoys to divine beings.
